name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: TanStack Table v9 data table. Sort by header click, search every column, filter by text or by a column's distinct values, and page through rows. Select rows with a checkbox column and run bulk actions on the selection. Resize, drag to reorder, pin to either edge, and hide columns; switch between compact, default and comfortable density. Show nested rows as an expandable tree with getSubRows, edit cells in place, and export the filtered rows as CSV or JSON.
